whatIs.headline: What is a Topographical Survey?
whatIs.description: A topographical survey provides a detailed representation of your land — capturing elevations, contours, natural features, and existing structures as they exist on the ground. It is the foundation of all engineering design and construction projects, giving architects, engineers, and planners the accurate site data they need to design with confidence.

whenYouNeed.headline: When Do You Need a Topographical Survey?
whenYouNeed.description: From the first design sketch to final county approval, an accurate topographical survey underpins every critical decision on your project.

items.title: Before architectural or civil design
items.description: To provide accurate ground levels and site features for precise design work.

items.title: Before construction approvals
items.description: Required for submission drawings and compliance with planning authorities.

items.title: For road, infrastructure, and drainage design
items.description: Enables proper alignment, grading, and stormwater planning.

items.title: For land development and subdivision
items.description: Defines terrain, access, and layout feasibility for planning and approvals.

children.title: Before submission of architectural and structural drawings for County approval (PPA2 / Development Permission)
children.description: Required to support planning applications under County Governments and Physical and Land Use Planning Act compliance requirements, ensuring accurate site context, access, and building positioning.

children.title: Before issuance of construction approval and NCA project registration
children.description: Forms part of the technical documentation required for NCA project registration, alongside approved drawings, BoQs, and consultant engagement documents.

children.title: For infrastructure design submissions (roads, drainage, water, and utility layouts)
children.description: Used by engineers and consultants to support design compliance with statutory standards for grading, drainage control, and service alignment.

children.title: For land subdivision, amalgamation, and development planning applications
children.description: Required for preparation and approval of mutation plans, ensuring compliance with Survey of Kenya and County physical planning requirements before survey plan authentication.

whatYouGet.headline: What You Get
whatYouGet.description: Every topographical survey is delivered as a complete, engineering-ready package.

items.title: Detailed features topographical map
items.description: Feature-rich map of the site: boundaries, structures, utilities, and levels.

items.title: Contour maps (major & minor intervals)
items.description: Contours at major and minor intervals for design and earthworks.

items.title: CAD drawings (AutoCAD-ready)
items.description: Layered CAD drawings that open directly in AutoCAD and civil design tools.

items.title: Digital Terrain Models (DTM)
items.description: Digital terrain models for cut-fill, drainage, and 3D site analysis.

items.title: XYZ coordinates data, spot levels and site features
items.description: Coordinates, spot levels, and coded features ready for engineering use.

items.title: Survey report
items.description: Signed report covering methodology, controls, and accuracy.

cost.headline: Topographical Survey Cost in Kenya
cost.description: Topographical survey pricing is influenced by site conditions and the level of detail required for engineering and approval purposes. Each project is assessed individually to ensure accurate and fit-for-purpose pricing.
factors: Site size and land use intensity (small plots vs large developments)
Terrain complexity (flat land, slopes, or heavily built-up areas)
Site accessibility (road access, vegetation cover, security conditions)
Required accuracy and deliverables (basic contours vs full engineering datasets such as DTM/DSM and CAD integration)
cost.priceRangeNote: This range applies to most residential, commercial, and mid-scale infrastructure projects across Nairobi, Kiambu and Kenya extensively. Large-scale developments, complex terrain, or high-precision engineering surveys may fall above this range.
cost.influencesTitle: What Influences Final Pricing for Our Clients
influences: Level of detail required for county approval or design engineering
Integration with GIS, CAD, or BIM workflows

section1.headline: See the Land as It Truly Is
section1.description: SmartGrid Surveying delivers highly detailed and accurate topographical surveys for engineering, planning, and construction. Whether in Nairobi, Kisumu, Mombasa — or across Africa and beyond — our expert team captures terrain with centimeter-level precision using GNSS, Total Stations, and Drone LiDAR Mapping.

items.title: Engineering - Grade Accuracy
items.description: We use state of art GNSS RTK, Total stations, UAV LiDAR and Automatic levels to achieve precise data for roads, drainage, features and construction design

items.title: Drone & Ground intergration
items.description: Seamless intergration of aerial and terrestrial data ensures consistent, detailed 3D terrain models and contours.

items.title: National & Cross Border Coverage
items.description: Our survey teams operate across Kenya, East Africa, and international territories - trusted by engineers, developers, and contractors worldwide.

detailedTopographicalSurveys.headline: Detailed Topographical Surveys Across East Africa!
detailedTopographicalSurveys.description: At SmartGrid Surveying Ltd, we specialize in delivering high-precision topographical surveys across East Africa, covering Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Burundi, Somalia, South Sudan, Ethiopia, and Other Parts of Africa. Our team of expert surveyors utilizes the latest technology, including GPS, drones, and total stations, to provide accurate and detailed mapping solutions for various projects.

items.title: Land Contours Mapping
items.description: Our advanced surveying techniques allow us to create detailed contour maps, providing essential information for land development, construction planning, and environmental assessments.

items.title: Land/ Man-made features
items.description: We accurately capture and map both natural and man-made features, including buildings, roads, vegetation, and water bodies, ensuring comprehensive data for your projects.

items.title: Infrastructure mapping
items.description: Our team specializes in mapping critical infrastructure such as utilities, transportation networks, and public facilities, providing valuable insights for urban planning and development.

items.title: Boundary Survey Inclusive
items.description: We conduct precise boundary surveys to establish property lines and legal boundaries, ensuring compliance with local regulations and preventing disputes.

items.title: Utilities mapping
items.description: Our utility mapping services identify and document underground and above-ground utilities, aiding in construction planning, maintenance, and safety.

items.title: Land Use reports
items.description: Our land use reporting services provide comprehensive analysis of current and proposed land use patterns, supporting informed decision-making for development projects.

items.title: 3D Data Collection
items.description: Our 3D data collection services utilize advanced technologies to create detailed and accurate 3D models of survey areas, supporting various applications in construction, planning, and analysis.

items.title: Data Processing(DEM, DTM,DSM, CAD shapefiles)
items.description: We provide comprehensive data processing services, including the generation of Digital Elevation Models (DEM), Digital Terrain Models (DTM), Digital Surface Models (DSM), and CAD shapefiles, ensuring that survey data is ready for analysis and application.

sampleTopographicalMap.headline: SAMPLE TOPOGRAPHICAL MAP
sampleTopographicalMap.description: SmartGrid Surveying conducted a comprehensive topographical survey in Usenge, Siaya County, focused on mapping and identifying existing and potential water pipeline infrastructure. This project supports the community's initiative to enhance water distribution efficiency and infrastructure planning across the region.

map.title: MAP HIGHLIGHTS

Legend detailing roads, pipelines, powerlines, and water facilities
Survey metadata including date, locality, client, and verification signatures
